notes: BDP system. Styles 1-4 match Bryant styles 1-4 in shape, positions, era, and example serials (style 2, style 3 and style 4 examples are identical serials on both pages). Payne is NOT usesStylesOf Bryant because Payne style 5 differs from Bryant style 5 and Payne lists no Canada variant for style 3. Styles 3-4 letter/digit tables are transcribed from Bryant page text because Payne's own charts are image-only in text fetch; confirm against Payne chart images before treating those tables as Payne-page-confirmed. HELD GAP — style 5 (prior to 1970, 7-digit all-numeric, year = 1st digit): the page shows only the placeholder 6######, which is not a real serial, and the decade mapping lives only in the chart image; no style 5 is shipped rather than guessed. Carrier is a related brand but its page states no serial system, so it is not claimed as sharing this system.

styles.era: 10-character format, week-year in first four digits
styles.notes: Week is 1st-2nd positions, year is 3rd-4th positions. Week decode for the example is 40.
Year is 1st-2nd positions, month is 3rd-4th positions. Same example serial as Bryant style 2.

Month is 1st position, year digit is 2nd position. Tables transcribed from Bryant page text for the identical BDP system; Payne's own chart is image-only in text fetch. Year uses a digit-keyed table because the schema digits kind cannot express a 1-character year.
